headline: Was The Run In Super Micro Stock Hiding In Plain Sight?
summary: Shares of Super Micro Computer (SMCI) rose 45.1% between July 17 and October 15, 2026. The S&P 500 gained 4.1% over the same period. During this window, the company reported a record order backlog and set a fiscal 2027 revenue target of $65 billion to $72 billion. That figure sits well above its fiscal 2026 sales.
